paper: Trade in Minutes! Rationality-Driven Agentic System for Quantitative Financial Trading
headline_strategy: TiMi uses macro-analysis, pair-specific strategy-adaptation, bot-evolution, and feedback-reflection agents offline to generate and hierarchically optimize a programmatic minute-level grid bot, then deploys the frozen bot with volatility-qualified pairs, layered limit orders, and progressive risk exits.
headline_selection_basis: Sections 2-3 and Algorithm 1 identify the optimized generated bot B*—not any one technical indicator—as the proposed policy-deployment-optimization chain and concrete headline strategy.
undisclosed_required_values_and_objects: runtime prompt templates, filled calls, responses and generated bot source
execution intervals T1 and volatility lookback T2
minimum volume V_req and volatility Phi_req
capital allocation A and position divisor lambda
price ladder M_P and quantity ladder M_Q
market-cap, funding-rate and entry scaling coefficients c_m, c_f and c_e
the macro strategy set, pair-specific adaptations and initial parameters
simulation feedback, risk scenarios, constraint matrices and optimization histories
the complete point-in-time 213-pair universe and frozen K-line/news inputs
fees, funding schedules, slippage observations, orders, fills, positions and return arrays
baseline configurations, random seeds, repeat counts and uncertainty outputs

official_supplement.interpretation: The supplement is known to have been listed but remains inaccessible; it is not claimed absent or inspected.

material_paper_findings: Figure 6 reports 61 OM and 45 SIGN orders while v2 prose reports 28 and 39.
The printed ARR equation is total return rather than an annualized return.
V2 acknowledges potential posterior information in LLM baselines without timestamped provenance.
Several live baseline coverage values are estimates from partial experiments.
The v2 backtest and ablations were added without raw run lineage.

rejected_substitutes.route: Use the previous momentum/liquidity/volatility JKP characteristic score
rejected_substitutes.reason: Its characteristics and signs are a researcher-created narrative motif and do not execute the generated TiMi bot, grid parameters, optimization, or feedback loop.
Every parameter that determines pair selection, order levels, position size and exits is undisclosed; choosing them would create a new grid strategy.
Both implementations appeared after the paper under authors with no paper-author identity match and cannot establish experiment lineage.

rejected_substitutes.route: Treat paper tables or transaction images as returns
rejected_substitutes.reason: They contain displayed summaries without orders, fills, portfolio paths or underlying arrays.

rejected_substitutes.route: Translate the futures/crypto minute grid directly to monthly U.S. stocks
rejected_substitutes.reason: The grid depends on intraday OHLC, funding, liquidity, maker fees, order-book execution and risk exits that monthly JKP does not represent.

result_policy: No thematic factor proxy, arbitrary grid parameterization, unaffiliated implementation, static paper output, or frequency/market substitution is entered as a TiMi monthly return. Reopen if the official supplement or attributable implementation becomes recoverable.
